sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Stick Merge, the core gameplay revolves around merging different types of guns to create more powerful ones. You'll start with a basic pistol, which can be upgraded and combined with other guns to create new and more powerful varieties. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new guns, ammo types, and power-ups that will help you take down the moving stick figures in the shooting range. The game's simplicity is its greatest strength, making it easy to pick up and play, but challenging to master. The game's physics engine adds a layer of realism to the gameplay, making it feel more immersive and engaging.


One of the key features of Stick Merge is its gun-merging system. By combining different guns, you'll create new and more powerful ones, each with its unique stats and abilities. The game also features a variety of power-ups, including ammo boosts, speed increases, and damage multipliers, which will help you take down the stick figures more efficiently. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new power-ups and guns, giving you more options to experiment with and find the perfect combination for your playstyle.


Another important aspect of Stick Merge is its progression system. The game features a level system, where you'll progress through different levels, each with its unique challenges and rewards. As you complete levels, you'll earn rewards, including new guns, power-ups, and cash, which can be used to purchase upgrades and equipment. The game also features a leaderboard, where you can compare your progress with other players and strive to become the best shooter in town.
